hints.tr: `on:` artık tek satır değil: altında iki boşluk içeride `push:` ve `pull_request:`.
hints.en: `on:` is no longer one line: under it, two spaces in, `push:` and `pull_request:`.

hints.tr: Her olayın altında dört boşluk içeride `branches: [main]`.
hints.en: Under each event, four spaces in, `branches: [main]`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

**.github/workflows/ci.yml**

```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python -m pytest
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

**.github/workflows/ci.yml**

```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python -m pytest
```
